ProductSearch::new.obligation: Create the one root vertex with no parent, exact state-to-ID entry 0, and cursor 0. Private concrete product triples, without a public unchecked model constructor.

pop.obligation: Read the current vertex with checked get; advance cursor once and return its stable ID and triple. Append-only vertex order is FIFO discovery order. None means every discovered vertex was processed.

admit.obligation: For a fresh product triple only, save the next dense ID and one earlier parent/input link. Existing triples keep their first discovery and parent. No full word is copied.

word.obligation: Follow valid strictly decreasing predecessor IDs to the root, collect input labels backwards, and reverse once. Reconstruct exactly the first shortest lexicographic discovery word. Called only for returned collision witnesses.

FiniteWordTransducer::new.signature:
pub fn new(
        alphabet_size: usize,
        initial: usize,
        transitions: Vec<Vec<usize>>,
        outputs: Vec<Vec<Vec<usize>>>,
        initial_output: Vec<usize>,
        final_outputs: Vec<Vec<usize>>,
    ) -> Result<Self, HistoryError>
FiniteWordTransducer::new.body:
{
        let n = transitions.len();
        if n == 0
            || initial >= n
            || outputs.len() != n
            || final_outputs.len() != n
            || transitions
                .iter()
                .any(|row| row.len() != alphabet_size || row.iter().any(|&x| x >= n))
            || outputs.iter().any(|row| row.len() != alphabet_size)
            || outputs
                .iter()
                .flatten()
                .chain(final_outputs.iter())
                .chain(std::iter::once(&initial_output))
                .flatten()
                .any(|&d| d >= alphabet_size)
        {
            return Err(HistoryError::InvalidTransducer);
        }
        Ok(Self {
            alphabet_size,
            initial,
            transitions,
            outputs,
            initial_output,
            final_outputs,
        })
    }

StateContextLift::new.obligation: Require valid start and an in-range action of memory-state length. BFS computes first shortest lexicographic representative histories. Reject exactly when a reachable source state has an unreachable action image. Unreachable source states impose no closure requirement. invariant_argument: FiniteWordTransducer privately owns a nonempty total control table, emission arrays, and initial/final words, all checked against the same alphabet. FiniteMoore supplies admitted nonempty total memory. Arbitrary caller-provided HistoryContext implementations have their own semantics; only the admitted finite transducer has this complete product algorithm. Empty alphabets are supported. Public construction and run/apply guards reject invalid indices and emitted symbols before indexing; no numeric approximation or hidden output normalization occurs.

For each input word w, the product vertex is (run(start,w), control after w, run(start, initial_output followed by transition emissions for w)). At the root this holds by construction. The source and control updates and emission run preserve it by induction. Final emissions are applied after the prefix to obtain exactly run(start, apply(w)); they are not fed back into a child product state. The Lean product_correct, final_correct, run_append, and coordinate lemmas prove this abstract all-word correspondence. Native expectations separately concatenate raw emissions and execute memory transitions.

The reachable product has at most memory_states squared times control_states vertices. Root inclusion and closure under every input cover every finite word; Lean closed_covers_all proves the universal closure argument. Every fresh triple gets one vertex and is queued once, so exhaustive exploration terminates on finite admitted tables, independent of word length. Arithmetic for this mathematical cardinality is not used as an unchecked Rust allocation size. Allocation availability remains standard-library TCB. The finite native oracle enumerates all words through the simple-path product bound for its small models; this is test evidence, rather than substituting a fixed cutoff for the implementation theorem.

Append-only vertex IDs and the processing cursor implement the same FIFO discovery order as the previous queue. Inputs are visited in ascending order. A fresh child records an already processed parent whose ID is strictly smaller; duplicate triples keep the first parent. Predecessor chains terminate, have at most the number of vertices minus one links, and reconstruct the same shortest lexicographic words previously stored in the map. This preserves first collision selection and both witnesses on all admitted inputs. Source comparison establishes the order correspondence; frozen-reference and direct non-palindromic reconstruction controls corroborate it.

For state descent, images[source] records the first final emitted-memory result for that source state, and its representative ID is initialized at the same time. A later unequal result returns two actual words with the same original state and different transformed states. If traversal closes without conflict, every reachable source state has one exact image and every unreachable state remains None. The reported product count is the complete distinct reachable vertex count. For profile noncongruence, the key is instead the literal source report and the value is the final target report. Thus state descent and report-kernel constancy are separate questions. The Lean realized-image factor theorem and collision refusal support both abstract kernels.

Verify_descent compares the full recomputed canonical result, including images/count or all collision fields and words. It does not assert an external declaration identity. Records are raw mutable reports and may be forged; exact replay rejects changed fields. Generic HistoryContext has no blanket totality or global descent guarantee. The actual finite transducer apply method emits precisely initial, per-step, and final words in order; free run implements the memory action with start validation before word validation.

StateContextLift performs the unchanged memory BFS. Each newly reached state receives its required owned first representative word, copied only at discovery; those words are exposed by the public API and cannot be elided. Closure is required only for reachable source states. Applying a valid history first reaches such a state, then returns the stored representative of its action image. This implements the state action on every history. Conversely any history lift makes each reachable action image reachable. Lean lifted_action, lift_requires_reachable, and lift_exists prove this boundary, without inventing chronology or identifying distinct states from equal reports.

Product searches now store triples and predecessor links, with one first-representative ID per source state or report. Successful searches copy no full history words; a collision materializes only the two required output words. Initial/final and per-transition emissions remain borrowed during product traversal. Required output images, maps, apply output words, and StateContextLift representative words remain owned. Concrete usize comparisons and library operations are the trust boundary; no arbitrary callback or macro algorithm is hidden. Cursor increments and parent indices are safe under append-only allocated-vector invariants. No explicit work or heap budget is promised for arbitrary models or output words.
